guide.title: Quick User Guide
guide.body:
1. Check [x] only the AI tools you want to synchronize; unchecked [ ] apps are never touched.
2. Choose Auto-Patch (one-click backup + repair + sync) or Manual Patch (preview exact diff first).
3. Every write verifies running app locks, creates a SHA-256 backup, and logs an immutable Apply Ledger.
4. Use Session Handoff to transfer conversations with rules and skills across Codex, Antigravity, Claude Code, and OpenCode.
5. Switch language anytime with [L] (English / Russian / Chinese).
